can: Consigo falar de viagens e culturas, usar orações com particípio e conectores de contraste e reclamar com tato.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Travel and culture (itinerary, accommodation, sightseeing, customs, souvenir, jet lag, culture shock, heritage, hospitality, off the beaten track).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: We waited an hour at customs.
I bought a souvenir for my mother.
I had terrible jet lag for three days.
Moving to Japan gave me culture shock.
The old town is a World Heritage site.
We were amazed by the local hospitality.
We found a lovely village off the beaten track.
That restaurant is a tourist trap.
There was a long delay at the airport.

items: **book / reserve** accommodation, a flight; **check in / check out**
**go sightseeing**, **go on a trip**, **take a day trip**
**travel** (verbo e incontável) x **trip** (uma viagem): *a long trip, a lot of travel*
**miss / catch** a flight; **pack / unpack** your luggage
"We booked a good accommodation." É incontável: **We booked good accommodation.**
"I made a travel to Italy." O certo é **I took a trip to Italy** (travel não é contável).
"The luggages were lost." **Luggage** é incontável: **The luggage was lost.**
"I'm going to travel in vacation." O certo é **on holiday** (ou **on vacation** em inglês americano).

After the long flight I had terrible jet ___.
We found a lovely village off the ___ track.
The hotel was clean and the local ___ was wonderful.
We booked a good accommodation near the beach.
acc: We booked good accommodation near the beach

exercises.prompt: I made a travel to Italy last year.
acc: I took a trip to Italy last year

lessons.title: Orações com particípio e conectores de contraste
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: participle clauses (-ing, -ed, having + particípio) e conectores de contraste (although, despite, whereas, however).

head: Estrutura
Sentido
Exemplo
rows: ação ao mesmo tempo ou que explica a outra
Walking down the street, I saw an old friend.
Having finished work, we went to the airport.
Built in 1900, the hotel is now a museum.
Although it was raining, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out. / Despite being tired, we walked.
Madrid is hot, whereas Oslo is cool.
porém, no entanto (frase nova, com vírgula)
The hotel was cheap. However, it was dirty.

items: O sujeito da oração com particípio é o **mesmo** da oração principal. *Walking down the street, a dog bit me* soa como se o cão estivesse caminhando.
**Despite of** não existe: **despite** (sem of) ou **in spite of**.
**Although ... but** não se usa junto. Escolha um: *Although it was cold, we went.* ou *It was cold, but we went.*
"Despite of the rain, we went out." O certo é **Despite the rain** ou **In spite of the rain.**
"Although it was cold, but we went out." O certo é **Although it was cold, we went out.**
"Finishing the work, I went home" (se terminou antes) fica melhor: **Having finished the work, I went home.**
"Despite he was tired..." O certo é **Although he was tired** ou **Despite being tired.**

exercises.prompt: ___ (walk) down the street, I met an old friend.
___ finished work, we went straight to the airport.
___ the rain, we enjoyed the tour.
Madrid is very hot, ___ Oslo is cool.
Despite of the rain, we went out.
acc: Despite the rain, we went out
In spite of the rain, we went out

exercises.prompt: Although it was cold, but we went out.
acc: Although it was cold, we went out
It was cold, but we went out

exercises.prompt: Despite he was tired, he kept walking.
acc: Although he was tired, he kept walking
Despite being tired, he kept walking
Even though he was tired, he kept walking

chat.goal: Usar 3 conectores de contraste (although, despite, however, whereas) e 2 orações com particípio.

lessons.title: Inglês prático, reclamar durante uma viagem
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Reclamar durante uma viagem.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'd like to make a complaint. / Excuse me, there seems to be a problem.
The room isn't as described on the website. / I was promised a sea view, but...
We've been waiting for over an hour. / The air conditioning doesn't work.
I'd appreciate it if you could change our room. / What can you do about it?
Would it be possible to get a refund / a discount?
Could I speak to the manager, please?

items: "I want a solution now!" é agressivo. Prefira **I'd appreciate it if you could fix this today.**
"The room is not like the photo." O certo é **The room isn't as it appears in the photos / isn't as described.**
"I'm waiting here since one hour." O certo é **I've been waiting here for an hour.**

exercises.prompt: I'd like to make a ___.
The room isn't as ___ on the website.
I'd ___ it if you could change our room.
Could I speak to the ___, please?
I'm waiting here since one hour.
acc: I've been waiting here for an hour
I have been waiting here for an hour

exercises.prompt: Escreva 3 frases para reclamar de um quarto de hotel sem ser grosseiro.
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.

chat.scenario: Você está num hotel que não entregou o que prometeu e conversa com o recepcionista.
chat.role: Recepcionista educado, que tenta resolver mas tem limitações.
chat.goal: Explicar o problema com fatos, pedir uma solução com tato e pedir uma compensação.

en.vocab: Travel and culture (accommodation, delay, customs, luggage, hospitality). Key terms: I'd like to make a complaint, I'd appreciate it if you could, as described, speak to the manager.
